defect: The original raw schema required participant_id to begin with SYNTH-. That correctly constrained the readiness dry run but contradicted the registered future pseudonymization interface, which must be able to represent institution-issued study-local participant IDs after an explicit collection GO.
repair: Permit either SYNTH- or MPBP- followed by uppercase letters, digits, or hyphens in the raw schema. The readiness and dry-run implementation must still reject every non-SYNTH participant ID. MPBP remains unusable until ethics, privacy, platform, and explicit user GO requirements pass.
scientific_invariance: No codebook, stimulus, renderer, randomization, A/B assignment, pair set, task count, timing, estimand, SESOI, sample size, exclusion, statistical equation, outcome branch, or collection-GO rule changes.
